dataset: PhotoTourism IMC-PT 2020 / Sacre Coeur with NeRF-W image membership
camera_provenance: Reuse supplied IMC-PT dense/sparse COLMAP cameras and sparse points; per-image intrinsics retained, no fresh pose estimation
scale: Uncalibrated reconstruction units; align and establish meters before physics
attribution: Snavely et al., Photo Tourism, SIGGRAPH 2006; IMC-PT 2020 collection; Martin-Brualla et al., NeRF-W, CVPR 2021 split; original photographer rights apply
mask_policy: Full images, no foreground masks; background included in metrics
release: IMC-PT 2020 sacre_coeur.tar.gz; NeRF-W selected_images/sacre.tsv; hashes recorded at download

split.policy: Keep official test membership (21 images); carve validation from official training images (950); exclude unlisted images; project full-image evaluation, not the appearance-adapted NeRF-W protocol

license: Check source dataset and original photographer terms; no blanket image redistribution permission assumed
